identity.name: Llama_3.1_8b_DobHerWild_R1_v1.1R
identity.summary: A merge of pre-trained language models created using mergekit.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: text-output language model merged from Llama-3.1-8B base models with no reported evaluation or guardrails, so it can generate factually inaccurate content.

possible_risks.description: A model might generate language that leads to physical harm.  The language might include overtly violent, covertly dangerous, or otherwise indirectly unsafe statements.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight text-generation model with no reported safety evaluation and lineage including a model named 'Dobby-Mini-Unhinged-Llama-3.1-8B', plausibly producing harmful language.

possible_risks.description: Manipulative prompts that use social engineering techniques, such as role-playing or hypothetical scenarios, to persuade the model into generating harmful content.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight chat-style text model with no reported safety evaluation is susceptible to manipulative role-play prompts that elicit harmful content.

specifications.model_size: 15.0 GiB of safetensors weights (16,060,556,336 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: This model was created by merging two other Llama-3.1-8B based models into a base model using the Model Stock merge method.
